name: ESQUECIMENTO GLOBAL, de José Nunes e Luca Argel
description: This is a new production by José Nunes and Luca Argel, blending theatre and music. The show is inspired by Chico Buarque's Ópera do Malandro and Bertolt Brecht's Ópera dos Três Vinténs.
longDescription:
ESQUECIMENTO GLOBAL, a new production by José Nunes and Luca Argel, combines theatre and music. The show draws inspiration from Chico Buarque's Ópera do Malandro and Bertolt Brecht's Ópera dos Três Vinténs.

The performance takes place at Teatro Municipal Constantino Nery in Porto. It runs from November 6 to November 8, 2026, with the first session starting at 21:30. Tickets are priced at €7.50 for a full-price entry, with discounts available for seniors, students, groups, and people with disabilities.
